Logs and diffs

What a job printed, line by line as it runs, and what changed between two versions of a text - a template, a setting, a translation.

A log

pre class="log" sets a job's output in the monospace font, wraps its long lines and scrolls in its own box once a max-h-* utility caps its height - give it tabindex="0" then, so the keyboard scrolls it too. A line in a span with data-tone - success, warning, danger, info or muted - takes that tone; the words still say what happened. With data-follow the end stays in view while lines come in, as in a terminal, unless the reader scrolled up to read an earlier one; back at the end, it follows again.

09:14:02 Import started: excursions.csv, 128 rows
09:14:02 Columns: title, price, date, seats, language
09:14:02 Row 1-20 read
09:14:02 Row 21-40 read
09:14:03 Row 41: no price, set to 0
09:14:03 Row 42-60 read
09:14:03 Row 61-90 read
09:14:04 Row 91: the date 2026-02-30 does not exist, skipped
09:14:04 Row 92-128 read
09:14:05 127 excursions imported, 1 skipped
		<pre class="log max-h-160" id="log-follow-lines" tabindex="0" data-follow aria-label="The import's output" dir="ltr"><span data-tone="muted">09:14:02</span> Import started: excursions.csv, 128 rows
<span data-tone="muted">09:14:02</span> Columns: title, price, date, seats, language
<span data-tone="muted">09:14:02</span> Row 1-20 read
<span data-tone="muted">09:14:02</span> Row 21-40 read
<span data-tone="warning"><span data-tone="muted">09:14:03</span> Row 41: no price, set to 0</span>
<span data-tone="muted">09:14:03</span> Row 42-60 read
<span data-tone="muted">09:14:03</span> Row 61-90 read
<span data-tone="danger"><span data-tone="muted">09:14:04</span> Row 91: the date 2026-02-30 does not exist, skipped</span>
<span data-tone="muted">09:14:04</span> Row 92-128 read
<span data-tone="success"><span data-tone="muted">09:14:05</span> 127 excursions imported, 1 skipped</span></pre>
		<div class="hstack gap-8"><button class="btn btn-secondary" type="button" data-docs-run="log-line" aria-controls="log-follow-lines">Add a line</button></div>

A diff

div class="diff" holds one element a line: an ins is a line added, marked "+" and tinted green, a del a line taken away, "-" and red, anything else a line kept. In a kept line, del and ins show the words changed inside it, side by side. Lines of code carry translate="no", so a page's translator leaves them as they are, and a log or a diff of code is dir="ltr" on a right-to-left page; a diff of Arabic words keeps the page's direction.

<header class="vstack gap-8"> <h1>Ang Thong by speedboat</h1> <h1>Ang Thong marine park by speedboat</h1> <p>A day among fortyforty-two islands.</p> </header> 
<div class="diff" role="group" aria-label="The changes of the page's title" dir="ltr">
	<span translate="no">&lt;header class="vstack gap-8"&gt;</span>
	<del translate="no">	&lt;h1&gt;Ang Thong by speedboat&lt;/h1&gt;</del>
	<ins translate="no">	&lt;h1&gt;Ang Thong marine park by speedboat&lt;/h1&gt;</ins>
	<span translate="no">	&lt;p&gt;A day among <del>forty</del><ins>forty-two</ins> islands.&lt;/p&gt;</span>
	<span translate="no">&lt;/header&gt;</span>
</div>

Accessibility

  • A log that scrolls is focusable and named, so a keyboard reaches it and a screen reader says what it is. A log the person waits on may be role="log", a live region that says new lines politely; one that prints many lines a second says a summary instead.
  • A diff says its changes in its signs and its words, not in its colors: a screen reader reads "+" and "-" before a line, and in forced colors an added word is underlined and a removed one struck through.
